_comment: INTERIM, #647: three allows the dogfood lean lane needs, tracked so a lane worktree actually receives them — a git worktree gets tracked files only, so the operator's gitignored .claude/settings.local.json can never be in one. lean-gate.sh's `entry` now copies that file into the lane worktree (#647 AC-1), which is the remedy that also works for consumers; this block covers the first round here, before any copy has run.
